**Finding: Deviation (GOVLAW)**

The agreement's only governing-law provision is § 20(h) (paragraph p0146), which selects Nova Scotia / Canadian law and the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the Nova Scotia courts. Nova Scotia is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term. There is no arbitration clause, so this does not reach walk-away territory.

Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted: replace only the jurisdiction and forum wording with New York law and exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, leaving the balance of the sentence intact, with Delaware / California / England and Wales offered as fallbacks in the comment.
